opportunities.name: United car rental search
opportunities.description: Search United's Car tab for a rental by pickup city, pickup and return dates, and pickup and drop-off times, then click Find cars.
steps: Open united.com and click the CAR tab in the Book widget.
Click the Pickup location field, type the city name, and choose the matching suggestion (e.g. 'Caldwell (Ohio), US').
Click the Rental dates Pickup field and choose the pickup day in the calendar.
Click the Drop off field and choose the return day.
Open the Pickup time dropdown and pick the time (e.g. 8:00 a.m.).
Open the Drop off time dropdown and pick the time (e.g. 12:00 p.m.).
Click Find cars.

instances.values: Pickup 'Caldwell (Ohio), US'; dates Apr 08 to Apr 13; pickup 8:00 a.m., drop-off 12:00 p.m.; Find cars at 84.0s.
Pickup 'Brooklyn - Central (New York), US'; dates Apr 09 to Apr 15; pickup and drop-off 10:00 a.m.; Find cars at 1007.5s.

opportunities.name: jetBlue flight search (roundtrip or one-way)
opportunities.description: Search jetBlue flights by origin airport or city, destination, trip type, departure and return dates, then continue through the proof-of-travel and sort prompts to view results.
steps: Open the jetBlue home page and confirm the trip type (Roundtrip or One-way) in the dropdown.
Click the From field, type the origin city, and choose the airport or metro option (e.g. 'New York, NY (JFK)' or 'New York City area (NYC)').
Click the To field, type the destination, and choose the airport (e.g. 'Miami, FL (MIA)' or 'Toronto, Canada (YYZ)').
Click the Depart field and pick the departure date in the calendar.
If roundtrip, click the Return field and pick the return date.
Optionally tick 'Use TrueBlue points' to search with points.
Click Search flights.
On the 'Flying today' or 'proof of return travel' prompt, click Continue to flight results.

instances.values: From New York, NY (JFK) to Miami, FL (MIA); roundtrip Mon Mar 27 to Fri Mar 31; 1 adult; Continue to flight results at 554.2s.
From New York City area (NYC) to Toronto, Canada (YYZ); one-way; depart Sat Apr 29; Continue at 750.2s.
From New York City area (NYC) to Aruba (AUA); roundtrip May 1 to May 5; TrueBlue points checked; Search flights at 1547.6s.

opportunities.name: Avis Budget careers job search by country, team and time type
opportunities.description: Filter Avis Budget Group openings by country, team and time type, then run the search and open a listing.
steps: Open the Avis Budget Group careers 'Openings' page.
Expand the Country filter and choose the country (e.g. United States of America).
Expand the Team filter and choose the team (e.g. Finance).
Expand the Time Type filter and choose Full time or Part time.
Optionally type a keyword or location in the search fields.
Click Search by job title or keyword.
Open the first matching listing to read its details.

instances.values: Country United States of America; Team Finance; Time type Full time; search at 594.9s; opened 'Accounts Payable Associate' at 602.7s.
Country United States of America; Team Finance; Time type Full time; search at 1776.6s.

opportunities.name: National Park Service Find a Park filter
opportunities.description: Filter the NPS Find a Park page by activity or topic (and optionally state) and run the search to list matching parks.
steps: Open the NPS Find a Park page.
Optionally open the By State dropdown and choose a state.
Open the By Activity dropdown, tick the activity (e.g. Junior Ranger Program), then close the list.
Or open the By Topic dropdown and tick the topic (e.g. Industry, Laborer and Worker).
Click Search.
Scroll the results list and open a park card of interest.

instances.values: Activity 'Junior Ranger Program'; Search at 27.7s; results 1 to 20 of 470.
Topic 'Industry, Laborer and Worker'; Search at 1050.4s.

opportunities.name: Paisly (jetBlue) hotel search with guests
opportunities.description: Search Paisly hotels by destination city, check-in and check-out dates, and room and guest counts, then optionally filter and sort the results.
steps: Open the Paisly hotels tab.
Click the location field, type the city (e.g. 'Texas City') and choose the matching suggestion.
Open the date picker and select check-in and check-out dates.
Open the Guests picker, set adults and children; for each child choose the age.
Click Update.
Click Search, then on the sign-in prompt click 'Search without signing in'.
Optionally tick hotel star, amenity filters and set the sort to Price (Low to High).

instances.values: Destination 'Texas City, TX'; default dates Mar 26 to Apr 2; 2 guests.
Destination 'Texas City, TX'; Apr 22 to Apr 25; 3 adults and 1 child age 6; Search at 1579.8s; filters 3 star and free airport transport and free breakfast; sort Price (Low to High).

opportunities.name: Product search on retail site with price or delivery filter
opportunities.description: Search a shopping site for a product keyword, apply a price or delivery filter, and open a result.
steps: Click the site's search box.
Type the product keyword and press Enter or choose a suggestion.
Apply a price filter (type a max price and click Go) or a delivery filter (e.g. Free delivery).
Review the results and click Add to cart or open a product.

instances.values: Menards: keyword 'swivel vacuum'; max price 150; Add to cart at 241.6s.
Google Shopping: keyword 'granitestone sandwich maker'; Free delivery filter at 632.8s.
Amazon: keyword 'wireless headphones'; max price field used; product 'EAORUL Active Noise Cancelling Headphones' opened at 1790.6s.

opportunities.name: MTA bridge and tunnel toll lookup by vehicle type
opportunities.description: Navigate the MTA site to Bridges and Tunnels tolls and open the toll rates for a chosen vehicle type.
steps: Open the MTA site and open the menu or the Fares & Tolls section.
Choose Bridges and Tunnels tolls (or Bridges & Tunnels under Agencies).
Open Toll Rates, then open Tolls by Vehicle.
Click the vehicle type tile (Cars, Motorcycles or Trucks).
Read the toll table for that vehicle type.

instances.values: Vehicle type Cars; reached via menu, Agencies, Bridges & Tunnels, then Tolls by vehicle, Cars at 718.2s.
Vehicle type Motorcycles; reached via Fares & Tolls, Bridges and tunnels tolls, Toll Rates, Motorcycles at 1667.7s, then Motorcycle Toll Rates.
